title: Rabbi Yehudah ben Pazi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Zohar Chadash, Bereishit](https://www.sefaria.org/Zohar_Chadash,_Bereshit.372), in the section “And God said: Let there be a firmament.” Rabbi Yosi ben Chalafta and Rabbi Yehudah ben Pazi were eating at the wedding feast of Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Shimon, and Rabbi Chiyya was sitting there as a child. They said, “Let us ask this child,” etc. If this is a received tradition, we will accept it; for Rabbi Chiyya is known to have been a Babylonian who went up to the Land of Israel only when he was already a leading sage of his generation, as explained in his entry.[^1]

notes.text: The conditional acceptance and chronological objection are Hyman’s comment, not part of the Zohar account.
